design.quote: We analyzed data from 4365 patients with a history of MI in the Alpha Omega Cohort

population.quote: patients with a history of MI

intervention.quote: Q4 of %g/d of UPF represented a low and a high ultra-processed diet, respectively

comparator.quote: Q1 and Q4 of %g/d of UPF represented a low and a high ultra-processed diet, respectively

follow_up.quote: Over a median follow-up of 14 y

primary_findings.quote: Compared with Q1, a high ultra-processed diet was not consistently or significantly associated with CVD and CHD mortality. However, it was associated with a higher risk of stroke mortality (HRper10% point increase: 1.21; 95% confidence interval: 1.02, 1.42)
